title: Power Redundancy Compliance (N+1)
exclusions: Does not certify physical cable dress, breaker torque, or thermal imaging; does not replace vendor-native ATS/PDU configuration backups; ignores branch circuit diversity or breaker-coordination studies unless DCIM publishes `load_on_loss_of_one_pct` for each monitored `pdu_id`.
evidence: Archived CSV/printout of scheduled `alert_pdu_redundancy_loss_of_one` results plus dashboard panels scoped to `index=power` `sourcetype="power:redundancy"` with `pdu_id` drilldowns for each quarter.

controlTest.positiveScenario: Ingest synthetic events into `index=power` sourcetype='power:redundancy' where `entity` satisfies `load_on_loss_of_one_pct` > 100 for UC-15.1.19 ('Power Redundancy Compliance (N+1)'). Run the saved search and confirm at least one alertable row with expected fields populated.
controlTest.negativeScenario: Ingest benign `power` / `power:redundancy` events where `entity` stays below `load_on_loss_of_one_pct` > 100, or exclude the test entity via `ops_exception_register.csv` with a valid window. Confirm zero alert rows for UC-15.1.19.

dataSources: Land stitched PDU/ATS redundancy posture on **`index=power`** using **`sourcetype="power:redundancy"`** with Splunk-extracted booleans **`feed_a_ok`** and **`feed_b_ok`** plus numeric **`load_on_loss_of_one_pct`** and dimensional **`pdu_id`** aligned to your DCIM workbook. Typical paths mirror App **PDU/ATS telemetry, DCIM rules**: poll management VLAN OIDs through **SNMP Modular Input ([Splunkbase app ID 1537](https://splunkbase.splunk.com/app/1537))** or **Splunk Connect for SNMP ([Splunkbase app ID 6266](https://splunkbase.splunk.com/app/6266))**, ingest DCIM-calculated headroom exports via **`inputs.conf`** HEC/syslog bridges, or reuse the same normalization job your DCIM batch publishes—verify props/transform keep the four mandatory fields populated every poll.

description: Continuously evaluates PDU and ATS-derived redundancy telemetry where each event exposes binary feed health (`feed_a_ok`, `feed_b_ok`) plus modeled `load_on_loss_of_one_pct` headroom against DCIM-derived loss-of-one envelopes.
value: Continuously evaluates PDU and ATS-derived redundancy telemetry where each event exposes binary feed health.... Timely UC-15.1.19 alerting on 'Power Redundancy Compliance (N+1)' reduces operational risk and delayed incident response before manual triage or audit channels escalate.
implementation: Bind DCIM loss-of-one load models to each `pdu_id`, forward normalized redundancy rows into `index=power` as `sourcetype="power:redundancy"`, schedule the catalog SPL every five minutes with suppression keyed on `pdu_id`, and pair automated findings with quarterly aisle walk-downs that confirm ATS source LEDs match Splunk.
visualization: Dashboard Studio absolute layout: background `splunk.rectangle` cards, top row `splunk.singlevalue` tiles for worst `load_on_loss_of_one_pct` and count of bad `feed_*` pairs, center `splunk.table` sorted on `pdu_id` with conditional coloring, paired `splunk.column` trend of `load_on_loss_of_one_pct` by `pdu_id`, and `input.timerange` token `global_time` bound to every `ds.search` per facility template.

knownFalsePositives:
1. **Maintenance window on `power`** — Planned work for 'Power Redundancy Compliance (N+1)' shifts `count` over `span=1h` while `host` remains in-scope for UC-15.1.19. Cross-check CMDB CHG.

2. **Batch `count` on `power:redundancy`** — Scheduled automation elevates `src` without crossing `load_on_loss_of_one_pct` > 100. Compare `_time` minute against the job schedule.

3. **Synthetic probe on `host`** — Health checks in `power` populate the same fields the SPL groups on. Exclude monitoring-tagged assets before paging.

4. **Onboarding burst for `power:redundancy`** — First 48h baseline for `host` is unstable; window via `ops_exception_register.csv`.

**Suppression mechanism:** `ops_exception_register.csv` keyed on `host`, `exception_reason`, `valid_until`.
detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Deploy ingestion consistent with **PDU/ATS telemetry, DCIM rules**: Heavy Forwarders running **SNMP Modular Input (Splunkbase app ID 1537)** or **Splunk Connect for SNMP (Splunkbase app ID 6266)** must reach PDU/ATS management interfaces on UDP/161–162 while DCIM batch jobs or REST exporters publish modeled headroom into the same pipeline—capture stanza names inside **`inputs.conf`** and route outputs to **`index=power`**.
• Confirm **`props.conf`** / **`transforms.conf`** normalize vendor payloads so every event exposes **`feed_a_ok`**, **`feed_b_ok`**, **`load_on_loss_of_one_pct`**, and **`pdu_id`** before alerting; Interactive Search over **`-24h@h`** should show numeric booleans without manual `rex`.
• RBAC: provision a **`power_redundancy_ops`** role with search/filter rights limited to **`index=power`** and **`sourcetype="power:redundancy"`**, grant **`schedule_search`** only to **`svc_facilities_scheduler`**, and document acknowledgement paths in **`docs/implementation-guide.md`**.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
• Poll PDU and ATS feeds at **300-second** intervals during steady state (tighten to **60 seconds** during maintenance windows) so `_time` aligns with utility transfers.
• Merge DCIM-derived **`load_on_loss_of_one_pct`** (from your capacity workbook or nightly CSV KV refresh) onto SNMP-enriched rows using **`lookup`** or indexed fields—never hardcode breaker states inside SPL.
• If HEC forwards DCIM-only metrics, bind tokens under **`http://<collector>:8088/services/collector/event`** and stamp sourcetype overrides to **`power:redundancy`** for parity with polled streams.

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
Paste the immutable catalog SPL into Search, narrow to **`index=power`**, save as **`alert_pdu_redundancy_loss_of_one`**, set **`dispatch.earliest_time=-5m`**, **`cron_schedule=*/5 * * * *`**, throttle on **`pdu_id`**, and route actions through email or webhook per facilities policy.

Step 3 — Validate
Spot-check firing **`pdu_id`** rows against live ATS switch positions or PDU web UI states; mismatches indicate stale SNMP walks or broken DCIM joins.

Step 4 — Operationalize & troubleshoot
Publish a Dashboard Studio overview with feed matrices, **`load_on_loss_of_one_pct`** gauges, and a table of offending **`pdu_id`** values; log each suppression tied to DCIM maintenance IDs for auditors.
